data.name: Rabindra
data.long_meaning: Rabindra is a Sanskrit and Bengali name that can be translated as 'Lotus-born' or 'Sky-born'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Rabh' (sky) and 'Indra' (lord). In Hindu mythology, Indra is the god of rain, thunderbolts, and the heavens, and the name Rabindra evokes a sense of divine creativity and intelligence. The name is also associated with Rabindranath Tagore, a renowned Bengali poet, artist, and philosopher.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine creative energy within us and the power of intelligence and wisdom to transform our lives. It is a name for those who are inspired by the divine and seek to express their creativity and intelligence in the world.
data.numerology_meaning: Rabindra is a name that resonates with the vibrant energy of the number 5. It is a name for those who are independent, adventurous, and always seeking new experiences. The number 5 is also associated with creativity, communication, and the power of the mind. Those named Rabindra are likely to be innovative thinkers, artists, and communicators who are always exploring new ideas and expressing their unique perspective on the world.
